# King IPTV Player

> A free, ad-free IPTV player for Android (7.0+), iPhone and iPad (iOS 17+) by ZaPlatform. It plays the user's own M3U / M3U8 playlist or Xtream Codes login. It hosts and provides no content and is not affiliated with any IPTV provider.

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zaplatform.kingiptv
- App Store (iPhone and iPad): https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/king-iptv-player/id6807144978
- Features: Xtream Codes and M3U/M3U8 (link or file), several sources, live TV with now/next from the provider's EPG (XMLTV), films and series with resume, search, favourites per source, picture-in-picture, subtitle and audio track choice, automatic libVLC fallback when the system player (ExoPlayer on Android, AVFoundation on iOS) cannot play a stream, stream info panel.
- Not included: channels or playlists, catch-up, recording. Not available for Android TV or Chromecast.
- Price: free on both stores, no ads, no in-app purchases.
- Privacy: no account, no analytics, no tracking, no server; credentials encrypted with an Android keystore key or the iOS keychain.
